'''Staff of the Forgotten''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] traded by the appropriate [[Forgotten]], [[collectors]] (Keepers) who can be found in the [[Throne of Secrets]] in exchange of a [[Book of Secrets]].

== Stats ==
:[[Energy]] +15
:<[[Damage type]]>: 11-22 (Requires 9 <[[attribute]]>)
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Energy +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Health +30

== Unique counterparts ==
*[[Traveler's Bo Staff]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Fire damage]] and requires [[Divine Favor]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], [[Energy Storage]], or [[Spawning Power]].
*[[Bohdalz's Fury]] has stats identical to the [[Channeling Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Bohdabi's Spire]] has stats identical to the [[Death Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Staff of Despair]] has stats identical to the [[Domination Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Staff of the Kinslayer]] has stats identical to the [[Soul Reaping]] version of this item.
*[[The Mindclouder]] has stats identical to the [[Illusion Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Alem's Remedy]] has stats identical to the [[Restoration Magic]] version of this item.
